what: Forward paper test (spec-audit CAP-18, story audit-30-paper). The rules below are frozen at the commit that adds this file (tag paper-rules-v1). Only sessions that open after that commit count. Never edited: a change is a new file (rules-v2.json) with its own freeze and its own ledger; past days are never re-simulated.
fake_money_only: AGENTS.md shared rule 7: fills are computed from Alpaca market data; no order is ever sent to any broker, paper or real.

source.universe_note: S4 runs on his-hot plus new-hot-raw, the corrected list (floors on the raw close of 2025-09-12; section 8 item 5), never new-hot. S5 runs on his-crypto plus new-crypto.

money.accounts: one $10,000 account per rule (S4, S5), each run under every cost model
money.sizing: a session's trades share the account: when n trades x $1,000 is more than the lesser of $10,000 and $10,000 + realized P&L so far (under that cost model), each is sized to that amount / n (sized_down). Fractional shares. Cash-secured shorts, no margin.

signal.gap: daily open(d) / daily close(previous bar) - 1, Alpaca SIP daily bars, adjustment=split, rounded to 9 decimals
signal.no_signal: no daily bar on d, or no earlier bar in the fetched lookback

rules.label: Short the run-up
rules.text: Short a hot stock at 09:45 ET when it opened 5%+ above yesterday's close; stop 5% above entry; cover at 15:55 ET.

rules.label: Short crypto stocks that open up
rules.text: Short a crypto-linked stock at 09:35 ET when it opened 5%+ above yesterday's close; stop 5% above entry; cover at 15:55 ET.

fills.bars: Alpaca SIP 1-minute bars, adjustment=raw, regular session 09:30-16:00 ET, keyed by bar open time
fills.entry: the open of the first 1-minute bar at or after entry_et; no such bar = skipped (no_bars)
fills.stop: from the entry bar on, the first bar whose high reaches entry x (1 + stop_pct/100) covers at max(that bar's open, the stop)
fills.exit: else the open of the first bar at or after exit_et; else the last bar's close
fills.pnl: shares x (entry - exit) - per-side costs on both fills - borrow fee

costs.reference: notes/research/strategy-as-code.md section 5b (small_cap and borrow_high), frozen here. Story 29 (CAP-17) may change app/backtest costs later; this test keeps these numbers until a rules-v2 freeze.

realistic.bps_per_side: 50 when the fill price is under $5, 30 under $10, else 5; plus 10 when the stock's 20-session average dollar volume (raw close x volume) before the session is under $50M
realistic.borrow_fee_applies_to: trades on names Alpaca does not flag easy_to_borrow (flag read when the day is simulated), including an unknown flag

costs.x2: every realistic per-side cost and the borrow fee doubled
costs.base: 5 bps per side, 20 bps when the fill price is under $10 (contracts rule 5); no borrow fee. For comparison with results/strategy-lab.json only.

benchmark.basis: total return, dividends reinvested: the product of each counted session's close-to-close factor on Alpaca daily bars adjustment=all, from the close of the last session before the first counted one

word: contracts rule 9 on the realistic return vs SPY: under 30 trades Not enough trades; return below 0 No; ahead 2+ pts Yes; within 2 Barely; behind 2+ No

vs_random.twin: each trigger session shorted at the daily open and covered at the daily close, $1,000, base costs (split-adjusted ratios, raw prices for the cost tier)
vs_random.pool: every (ticker, counted session) of the rule's lists with a daily bar and an earlier bar
vs_random.band: 2.5th to 97.5th percentile of the random draws' P&L; the twin's percentile rank

counts_from: the first session whose 09:30 ET open is after the freeze commit's time
data_budget: at most 200 new 1-minute ticker-days per run; a day is simulated whole or not at all
